meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 集成 Webex 聊天通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要在应用中添加 Webex 消息功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat channel into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex messaging to your application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会自动把 Webex 的接入组件装进项目，完成注册、安装依赖、构建和测试；然后请你提供 Webex 机器人令牌和验证密钥，存好后 Claude 就能在 Webex 空间里收发消息。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 Webex 集成、配置 Webex 机器人或把 Webex 接到当前项目时触发。

say.text: 请帮我添加 Webex 集成
say.note: 自动完成适配器复制、注册和测试。

say.text: 我要把 Webex 机器人接到当前项目
say.note: 技能会配置通道并引导你提供机器人令牌。

say.text: Webex 设置需要我提供什么？
say.note: 技能会先安装组件，再提示你创建机器人并填入密钥。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will automatically add the Webex chat adapter to the project, register it, install dependencies, build, and run tests. It will then ask you for your Webex bot token and webhook secret, and once saved, Claude can send and receive messages in Webex spaces.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add Webex integration, configure a Webex bot, or connect Webex to the current project.

say_en.text: Please add Webex integration for me.
say_en.note: Starts the skill and runs the adapter setup automatically.

say_en.text: I want to connect a Webex bot to the current project.
say_en.note: Configures the channel and prompts for the bot token.

say_en.text: What do I need to provide for Webex setup?
say_en.note: Installs then guides bot creation and secret entry.
